# Kostadin Devedzhiev – Profile Summary

## 🧑‍💻 Professional Summary

**PhD student in Human-Inspired AI** at the **Centre for Human-Inspired AI (CHIA), University of Cambridge**, part of the **Trustworthy AI Lab** advised by **Professor Umang Bhatt**.

Research focus: **human-AI interaction** — designing multi-agent systems where AI agents and humans collaborate under real-world conditions such as varying expertise, cost, and availability. Building **Tailor**, a platform for designing workflows with built-in human oversight and governance controls for regulated industries.

Previously a **Software Engineer at Stellar Cyber**, building AI-driven interfaces for threat hunting and human-augmented autonomous cybersecurity operations powered by agentic AI.

## 🔬 Current Work

### **Tailor**
- A human-AI orchestration platform for designing workflows where AI agents and humans collaborate seamlessly.
- Visual workflow builder, specialized AI agents, human-in-the-loop review, and four levels of governance controls — from autonomous AI to human-led — built for regulated industries (healthcare, finance, legal).
- [tailorworkflow.com](https://tailorworkflow.com)

### **MARL-Align**
- A multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for LLM value alignment.
- Formalizes alignment as a decentralized POMDP and uses social welfare functions to train group-personalized language models, balancing individual user preferences with collective societal welfare through fairness-aware optimization.

---

## 💼 Work & Research Experience

### **Stellar Cyber** | *Software Engineer* (May 2022 – Sep 2025)
- Built autonomous SOC AI agents for security triage — headliner at RSA 2025 & Black Hat 2025.
- Built the chat UI, session management, and visualization suite for **Open XDR Investigator**, a GenAI cybersecurity copilot (RSA 2024, Black Hat 2024).
- Implemented bidirectional WebSocket pipelines with parallel data + LLM requests, reducing response times by 70%.
- Built knowledge-enriched GPTs for log analysis, metrics evaluation, and data source classification.
- Maintained 90%+ test coverage; reduced bug filings by 34% year-over-year.

### **Stony Brook University** | *NLP Research Assistant* (2021–2022)
- Designed **Recursive QA**, an annotation framework based on parse tree-derived QA tasks.
- Built a full-stack annotation web app; reached 80% agreement rate and ~30-second annotation speed.

### **University of Hawaii at Hilo** | *AI Research Assistant* (2020)
- Built a semi-automatic image annotation tool for invasive species identification via drone imagery and CNNs.
- Developed an API for holographic fan display control; built the Data Viz lab website.

### **Vivansa** | *Software Engineering Intern* (2019)

## 📚 Selected Publications & Working Papers

### *Motional EMF Generated by Squeezing an Elliptical Conducting Loop*
- **European Journal of Physics (2020)**
- DOI: [10.1088/1361-6404/abb066](https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6404/abb066)

### *Humans as Sensors: Cost-Aware Routing for Structured Human–AI Information Gathering*
- Treats humans as callable sensors that agentic AI systems query to reduce uncertainty — shifting the human role from "in the loop" to "on call."

### *MobileAgents: Mobile Multimodal Interface for Controlling Teams of AI Agents On the Go*
- Open-source mobile platform for managing AI agents via text, voice, and images, with configurable transparency levels.

### *Threat Explorer: Agentic Architectures and Visualization for Cybersecurity Analytics*
- Conversational AI system translating natural language to SQL over a 40,000-record attack dataset; compares LLM Chain, ReAct, and multi-agent architectures.

## 💡 Projects

### **GONEXT.lol**
- League of Legends analytics platform on a multi-agent LLM architecture with transparent reasoning (thinking trail + MCP logs).
- [gonext.lol](https://gonext.lol) · [GitHub](https://github.com/KostadinDev/gonext)

### **Knowledge Base Builder**
- Consolidates heterogeneous research artifacts into structured Markdown knowledge bases for RAG systems and llms.txt files.
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/knowledge-base-builder/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/kostadindev/knowledge-base-builder)

### **League of Legends MCP Server**
- Open-source Model Context Protocol server with 35+ tools exposing Riot Games API data to LLMs.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/kostadindev/League-of-Legends-MCP) · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/league-mcp/)

### **Recursive QA**
- NLP annotation framework using QA pairs generated from constituency parse trees.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/KostadinDev/Recursive-QA)

### **Deep Gestures**
- Real-time gesture recognition on the Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense microcontroller.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/KostadinDev/deep-gestures)
